note: The merfolk's village on the sea floor of Erud's Crossing, west of the hut island, all of it under the water. Its people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Erud's Crossing): Elder Coralyn, in the middle of the village, gives the first two and the level 20 road; Tidewarden Merrow, a few strokes north-west of her, the hunts; Shellwright Pearla, a few strokes south, is the outfitter; Gatekeeper Thalassa waits north-west of the village. Coachman Dorran keeps the stable up on the island's north shore, east of the village, on dry ground, so riders of every race land where they can breathe. The shore crabs (west of the village), the strand turtles (south of it) and Old Snapjaw, an old shark in the deep water far to the west, are placed for these quests. Merfolk speak of the tide and the sea, warmly, with a song never far off.

L1.name: A Shell for the Shore
offer: Welcome to the village, little fin. Up above is the land, loud and dry, but you will learn it, as we all did.
Every young one of the village wears a tide shell, so the sea knows its own. Shellwright Pearla carves them, a few steps south of here.
Will you fetch your shell and show it to me?
L1.declined: The tide will bring you back to me.
L1.started: Pearla is a few strokes to the south.

piece.name: tide shell earring
piece.description: A small spiral shell from the warm shallows of Erud's Crossing, carved for a young one of the merfolk.

fetch.journal: Ask Shellwright Pearla, a few strokes south of Elder Coralyn, for a tide shell.
fetch.says: A new fin on the strand! Hold still. There: listen to it and you will hear the sea, wherever you are.

show.journal: Show the tide shell earring to Elder Coralyn.
show.says: It suits you. Now the sea will know you, even on the land.

L2.name: Anchored at the Strand
offer: The land unmakes careless swimmers. Have Spiritmaster Nerissa anchor your spirit to the strand, so the tide brings you home.
Then give your name to Coachman Dorran for his ledger. He keeps his coach up on the island's shore, east of the village, and it runs to Freeport and to the other homes.
Will you see them both and return to me?
L2.declined: Then swim no farther than you can swim back.
L2.started: Nerissa waits to the south-west. Dorran is up on the island's shore to the east.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Nerissa, south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the strand.
bind.says: It is done. Whatever drowns you on the land, the tide will bring you back here. Now give Coachman Dorran your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Dorran, up on the island's shore east of the village, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A fin up on the dry shore? Stranger things have ridden my coach. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now you have a place in the village to come home to.
Tidewarden Merrow, a few steps north-west, has work for you. Listen to him: he is grumpy, but he is right.

L3.name: Crabs on the Strand
offer: The new fin. Good. The shore crabs have grown bold on the sea floor west of the village, and they pinch the little ones at play.
Thin them, and bring me three of their claws. Then I will teach you a thing the tidewardens know.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then the little ones keep their toes out of the water.
L3.started: Three claws. West, along the sea floor.

drop.name: shore crab claw
drop.description: The claw of a shore crab from the sea floor west of the merfolk's village.

hunt.journal: Take three shore crab claws from the shore crabs on the sea floor west of the village.

give.journal: Bring three shore crab claws to Tidewarden Merrow.
give.says: Three claws, and all your fingers still on. Now watch, and learn this.

L4.name: Arms from the Sea
offer: You will need better than your bare hands among the dry folk. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what it needs.
Shellwright Pearla has cord and a shaft set aside. Then take a shell plate from the strand turtles on the sea floor south of the village.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.started: Cord and a shaft from Pearla, a shell plate from the turtles. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Shellwright Pearla for the silk cord and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Merrow? He never says please. Here: cord, and a shaft cut straight from driftwood.

drop.name: strand turtle shell plate
drop.description: A plate of a strand turtle's shell from the sea floor south of the merfolk's village.

hunt.journal: Take a shell plate from the strand turtles on the sea floor south of the village.

give.journal: Bring the silk cord, the wooden shaft and the shell plate to Tidewarden Merrow.
give.says: All three. A moment... there. It is yours. Keep it bright: the salt is hard on steel.

L5.name: Old Snapjaw
offer: One task more. An old shark hunts the deep water far west of the village. Old Snapjaw, the little ones call him, and he has taken fish from our nets for years.
He is mean and he is old, and he will come at you on sight. Bring him down, and bring me a tooth of his so the village knows.
Will you hunt Old Snapjaw?
L5.declined: He will be there. He always is.
L5.started: West, out past the crabs, into the deep water. He will see you first.

drop.name: Old Snapjaw's tooth
drop.description: A long, notched tooth of Old Snapjaw, the old shark of the deep water west of the merfolk's village.

hunt.journal: Take a tooth from Old Snapjaw in the deep water far west of the village.

give.journal: Bring Old Snapjaw's tooth to Tidewarden Merrow.
says: The old snapper is gone? The nets will be full tonight. You are a little fin no longer.
Learn this, and go to Gatekeeper Thalassa, north-west of the village, when you are ready for Highbourne.

flight.name: The Tide to Highbourne
offer: The scholars of Highbourne, on Tunaria's western shore, have long traded with the merfolk. They will teach you as one of their own.
You have earned the tide, little fin. I will set you down among your own guild in Highbourne, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Highbourne?
flight.declined: The tide will wait for you.
flight.started: Swim well, and sing for us!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thalassa when you are ready to go to Highbourne.

L7.name: Two Tasks on the Ice
offer: The Homelands keep a hunters' outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie. Every home sends its young hunters there, and so will the strand.
Ride Dorran's coach to the Eyrie. Bring me drift rat fur and a badger's pelt from the snow east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow for me?
L7.declined: The snow will keep. Come back when you are ready.
L7.started: Dorran's coach will take you. Keep your scales warm: that water is frozen.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the drift rat fur and the badger pelt to Tidewarden Merrow.
give.says: Good fur, and a good pelt. The cold did not stop you. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L10.name: Arms of the Eyrie
offer: You have grown past the arms of a little fin. I will make you better, but the outpost has what I need.
Quartermaster Dunmore keeps good ore at the Eyrie outpost. Then bring me silk from the rime spiders north-east of it.
Will you bring me the ore and the silk?
L10.declined: Then your old arms will have to do.
L10.started: Ore from Dunmore, silk from the spiders. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Merrow needs.
materials.says: One of the merfolk, this far from the sea? Merrow's word came by the coach. Here, the best ore in my stores.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Tidewarden Merrow.
give.says: Ore for the blade, silk to bind the grip. A moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

L13.name: Old Frostjaw
offer: The outpost's hunters have lost three of their own to an old snow leopard they call Frostjaw. He hunts the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Bring him down, and I will teach you what the tidewardens teach at your age. Take friends from the other homes if you are wise.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.declined: He will not grow old enough to die on his own.
L13.started: Go with friends. He strikes first and he strikes hard.

hunt.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Frostjaw is gone? Then the outpost sleeps easier, and the strand is proud of you. Learn this.

L15.name: The Heart of the Rime
offer: Something old walks in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The hunters call it the Rimeheart, and the cold that follows it kills the snow's game.
Break it, and carry a shard of it to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.started: Do not go into those caves alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: So the Rimeheart is broken, and by one of the merfolk. I will send word to every home. Tell Merrow the Eyrie owes the strand a debt.

back.says: Halvek's word came by the coach before you did. You have done the strand proud. Learn this.

L20.name: The Long Tide
offer: Merrow says you are no little fin now. One of the merfolk who goes out into the world stands a watch at the Eyrie once, so the other homes know us.
Go to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost and do as he asks. When it is done, come back to me, and choose your path.
Will you stand the watch?
L20.declined: The tide waits for those who are ready.

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Coralyn sends you? Then you are ready for the eyrie. Scout Feyla watches it from the river's far reach: go to her.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Bring me three, and they will think twice before they raid the river again.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three talons. The eyrie will be quiet tonight. Go home, swimmer: your elder waits for you.

final.journal: Return to Elder Coralyn in the merfolk's village.
final.says: You swam out a little fin and came home a hunter of the Homelands. The strand has one more thing to give you.
